prompt:
Create a 2 minute 30 second instrumental event piece about charge separating in a cloud then splitting as lightning. Around 126 BPM felt as tension, C minor. Long static grain and rising filtered noise; the strike is a bright harmonic slash, not a cartoon thunderclap; aftershock is a low drone. Scientific, physical. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no lyrics, no hummed melody-as-voice, no singing, no whispered speech. No trap 808, no horror stingers, no rain-sample bed.

[00:00–00:40] Dry static grain, slowly widening spectrum, almost no pitch.
[00:40–01:15] Filtered noise climbs; tiny clicks like corona.
[01:15–01:25] Harmonic slash, very short, then hollow air.
[01:25–02:00] Low thunder-drone rolls, no snare, no crash cymbal.
[02:00–02:30] Static returns thinner, as if the field is resetting.
